#  Begin METADATA documentation

#  DATASET_NAME: 	pasum_pub.wellsites.txt 	
#  DATASET_DESCRIPTION: This data set contains site information for wells 
#			included in a report that summarizes the 
#			quality of water from wells sampled in principal 
#                       aquifers of the United States by the NAWQA program 
#			from 1991-2010. 
#			
#  DATA_SET FORMAT:	Tab-delimited ascii text
#  DATA_SET URL:	TBD
#
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
#  REPORT TITLE: 	Water quality in principal aquifers  
#			of the United States, 1991-2010
# 
#  REPORT SERIES/NUMBER:USGS Circular 1360
#  REPORT URL:		http://pubs.usgs.gov/circ/1360
#			
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  NAWQA STUDY:		Principal Aquifers: Summary Circular
#
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
#  METADATA DATE:    	May 28, 2013
#  METADATA CONTACT: 	Leslie DeSimone

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  METADATA Data Description:  
#
#  ABSTRACT:  This data set contains station identifiers, principal 
#       aquifer and principal aquifer lithology, water-use information, 
#       NAWQA study code, NAWQA study code type, and state and county
#	location for wells used in a report that summarizes the 
#       quality of water in principal aquifer sampled by the NAWQA program, 
#       1991-2010. The data were compiled mostly between November 2009 
#       and July 2010. 
#
#  SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION:
#   	PROCEDURES USED:
#	PROCESS STEP:
#	  Site information for wells was retrieved from the NAWQA internal 
#            Data Warehouse (DWH) in November 2009, with queries that
#            retrieved all groundwater sites.
#
#       PROCESS STEP:
#         Wells associated with specific types of NAWQA studies were removed
#            from the site list. These included sites associated with:
#            1. Agricultural Chemicals Topical studies (ACT sites)
#            2. Source-water quality assessments studies of finished
#                  water (DWGF sites)
#            3. Source-water quality assessments studies of source
#                  water (DWGS sites)
#            4. Flow-path studies (FPS sites)
#            5. Ecological studies (ECO and FIS sites)
#            6. Trend studies (TRN sites)
#            7. Mercury studies (HG sites)
#            8. Nutrient enrichment studies (NEET sites)
#            9. Most special studies (SPCG and SPCB sites)
#            10. Transport of anthropogenic and natural contaminant studies
#                   (TANC sites)
#            11. Several other miscellaneous studies
#
#	PROCESS_STEP
#         Sites were assigned to principal aquifers, using information in
#         the DWH, for example, the parameters "NAT AQFR CD" and "AQUIFER
#         NAME", which describe the aquifer from which the well draws water.
#         Principal aquifer names and lithologic categories are modified
#         from Miller (2000) and U.S. Geological Survey (2003a, 2003b).
#
#	  References: 
#	  Miller, J.A., ed., 2000, Ground water atlas of the United States: 
#	    Reston, VA, U.S. Geological Survey, variously paginated.
#	  U.S. Geological Survey, 2003a, Principal aquifers, in National 
#	    Atlas of the United States of America, 1 sheet, 1:5,000,000 
#	    scale, available at http://www.nationalatlas.gov/wallmaps.html.
#	  U.S. Geological Survey, 2003b, Principal aquifers of the 48 
#	    conterminous United States, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. 
#	    Virgin Islands: U.S. Geological Survey, Madison, WI, 1:2,500,000 
#	    scale, accessed September 12, 2006 at 
#	    http://nationalatlas.gov/metadata/aquifrp025.faq.html. 
#
#       PROCESS_STEP
#	  The site list and principal aquifer assignments were reviewed 
#         by members of the NAWQA Groundwater Status and Trends principal  
#	  aquifer teams. Based on these reviews, some sites were added. These
#         included sites from a number of DWGS studies and 1 TANC study that 
#         were being used in principal aquifer assessments.
#
#	PROCESS_STEP
#	  Sites with no water-quality data were removed from the site list 
#	  in April 2011
#
#	PROCESS_STEP
#	  Only wells with nawqa_suc1_type = "sus", "lusag", or "lusur" were
#         used in the data analysis for Circular 1360, unless otherwise
#	  indicated. 
#
#	PROCESS_STEP
#	  The 15-digit station identifier was replaced with a sequential
#	  well identifier.
#
#
# Related_Tabular_Data_Sets:  
#	pasum_pub.archival_file_summary.txt
#	pasum_pub.wellchars.txt	
#	pasum_pub.field.txt		
#	pasum_pub.majors.txt
#	pasum_pub.tes.txt
#	pasum_pub.nutrients.txt
#	pasum_pub.radon.txt
#	pasum_pub.pesticides.txt
#	pasum_pub.pesticides-CAL.txt
#	pasum_pub.vocs.txt
#	pasum_pub.vocs-CAL.txt
#

#	state
#	state_postal_code
#	county
#
#     DATA TYPES: 
#
#	Note:  The row in the data file that follows the row of variable 
#	names describes the width of the field and the data type. 
#	Code:	Variable Type		Variable Length
#	----------------------------------------------------------------
#	s 	text variable		numeric value preceding code 
#	n	numeric variable	numeric value preceding code
#									 
#	For example: 15s indicates a 0- to 15-character text variable whereas
# 	9N indicates a 0- to 9-digit numeric variable.
#
#
#     DATA SOURCES:
#	DWH	= USGS NAWQA data warehouse, accessible publicly at: 
#                    http://water.usgs.gov/nawqa/data
#
#
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  METADATA Detailed documentation of dataset elements:
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
#	Data FIELD GROUP: SITE IDENTIFICATION
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: well identifier
#       Data Field Description: sequential identifier; the first 4 letters
#		are abbreviations representing the principal aquifer or group 
#		of principal aquifersin which the well is located for aquifers
#		that are the subjects of regional principal aquifer assessments,  
#		which are published in separate U.S. Geological Survey Circular
#		reports, as follows:
#		DENV = Denver Basin aquifers, Circular 1357
#		UFSF = Upper Floridan and Surficial aquifers, Circular 1355
#		GLAC = Glacial aquifer, Circular 1352
#		HPGW = High Plains aquifer, Circular 1337
#		METX = Mississippe Embayment-Texas coastal uplands aquifer
#		  system and Mississippi River Valley Alluvial aquifer, 
#		  Circular 1356
#		NACP = Northern Atlantic Coastal Plain aquifer system, 
#		  Circular 1353
#		PBVR = Piedmont, Valley and Ridge, Blue Ridge, and Early
#		  Mesozoic basin aquifers, Circular 1354
#		SWPA = Basin and Range basin-fill, California Coastal basin, 
#		  Central Valley, and Rio Grande aquifers, Circular 1358 
#		WEVO = Columbia Plateau, Snake River Plain, and Hawaiian
#		  aquifers, Circular 1359
#		OTHR = All other aquifers
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: calculated
#       Retrieval Date: not applicable
#
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
#	Data FIELD GROUP: PRINCIPAL AQUIFER INFORMATION
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: principal_aquifer_lithology_code
#       Data Field Description: 1-2 letter abbreviation for principal aquifer 
#		lithology:
#		A = basalt and other volcanic-rock aquifers
#		B = crystalline-rock aquifers
#		C = carbonate-rock aquifers
#		D = sandstone and carbonate-rock aquifers
#		E = sandstone aquifers
#		F = semi-consolidated sand aquifers
#		G1 = glacial aquifers
#		G2 = unconsolidated sand and gravel aquifers
#		H = unknown or other
#	Data Field Length/Type:	2s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: determined for this report
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: principal_aquifer_lithology
#       Data Field Description: lithologic category of principal aquifer from 
#		which well withdraws water
#	Data Field Length/Type:	60s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: modified from DWH and National Atlas (Miller, 2000;
#		U.S. Geological Survey, 2003a, 2003b; see above)
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#		
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: principal_aquifer
#       Data Field Description: principal aquifer from which well withdraws 
#		water
#	Data Field Length/Type:	80s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: modified from DWH and National Atlas (U.S. Geological 
#		Survey, 2003)
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: glacial_region
#       Data Field Description: one of four regions of the glacial aquifers 
#	Data Field Length/Type:	15s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: determined for this report
#       Retrieval Date: May 2011
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: number_principal_aquifers
#       Data Field Description: number of principal aquifers with which the
#               the well is included for aggregation of water quality
#	Data Field Length/Type:	2n	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: determined for this report
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
#	Data FIELD GROUP: WATER USE INFORMATION
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: water_use_code
#       Data Field Description: code that identifies two types of
#               drinking-water wells:
#		PWS = public-supply well
#		DOMESTIC = domestic well
#	Data Field Length/Type:	10s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: modified from DWH item "primary_water_use"
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: primary_water_use
#       Data Field Description: use of water from DWH:
#	Data Field Length/Type:	20s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
#	Data FIELD GROUP: NAWQA GROUNDWATER STUDY INFORMATION
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: nawqa_sucode1
#       Data Field Description: code that identifies the NAWQA groundwater
#               study for which the well was sampled. For wells in multiple
#               studies nawqa_sucode1 was chosen as the first of studies after  
#               priortizing study types as follows:
#               sus > lusag > lusur > lusfo, lusmi, lusot, ref > spc > tanc.
#	        Note that only wells with nawqa_suc1_type = "sus", "lusag", or 
#	        "lusur" were used in the data analysis for Circular 1360, unless
#         	otherwise indicated. 
#
#	Data Field Length/Type:	10s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: nawqa_suc1_type
#       Data Field Description: Type of study for nawqa_sucode1:
#                  dwgs = public-well study (source-water quality assessment
#                     study)
#		   lusag = agricultural land-use study
#                  lusfo = forested land-use study
#                  lusmi = mining land-use study
#                  lusot = other land-use study
#                  ref = reference wells
#		   lusur = urban land-use study
#		   sus = major aquifer study
#                  spc = special studies
#                  tanc = transport of contaminants study
#	Data Field Length/Type: 12s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: nawqa_sucode2
#       Data Field Description: code that identifies the NAWQA groundwater
#               study for which the well was sampled. For wells in multiple
#               studies nawqa_sucode2 was chosen as the first of studies after  
#               priortizing study types as follows:
#               sus > lusag > lusur > lusfo, lusmi, lusot, ref > spc > tanc
#	Data Field Length/Type:	10s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: nawqa_suc2_type
#       Data Field Description: Type of study for nawqa_sucode2; 
#               see nawqa_suc1_type for explanation of codes
#	Data Field Length/Type: 12s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: nawqa_sucode3
#       Data Field Description: code that identifies the NAWQA groundwater
#               study for which the well was sampled. For wells in multiple
#               studies nawqa_sucode3 was chosen as the first of studies after  
#               priortizing study types as follows:
#               sus > lusag > lusur > lusfo, lusmi, lusot, ref > spc > tanc
#	Data Field Length/Type:	10s	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: nawqa_suc3_type
#       Data Field Description: Type of study for nawqa_sucode3: 
#               see nawqa_suc1_type for explanation of codes
#	Data Field Length/Type: 12s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: number_sucodes
#       Data Field Description: number of NAWQA groundwater studies with which the
#               the well is included for aggregation of water quality
#	Data Field Length/Type:	2n	
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: determined for this report
#       Retrieval Date: November 2009 to July 2010
#
#--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
#	Data FIELD GROUP: LOCATION INFORMATION
#		
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: state
#       Data Field Description:	state in which the well was located 
#	Data Field Length/Type: 20s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: May 2013
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: state_postal_code
#       Data Field Description:	2-letter abbreviation for state in 
#	    	which the well was located 
#	Data Field Length/Type: 3s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: May 2013
#
#       DATA FIELD LABEL: county
#       Data Field Description:	county in which the well was located 
#	Data Field Length/Type: 50s
#	Data Units: not applicable
#       Data Source: DWH
#       Retrieval Date: May 2013
#
#
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  End METADATA documentation
#
#  BEGIN DATA: pasum_pub.wellsites.txt
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
